fields.title: 📖 Imām Aḥmad: Ji wir bigire ku Imām jê girtine
fields.body:
🖋️ **Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** got:

> ***„Imām Aḥmad bi wate got: ‚Ne min korane bişopîne, ne Mālik, ne ash-Shāfiʿī, ne al-Awzāʿī û ne ath-Thawrī; belê ji wir bigire ku wan jê girtine.‘“***

🌙 **Encam:** Imām nexwestin girêdaneke kor bi navan ve, belê veger li Qurʾān, Sunnah û delîleke paqij.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn al-Qayyim, Aʿlām al-Muwaqqiʿīn, Aussage von Imām Aḥmad: lā tuqallidnī wa lā tuqallid Mālikan...
immutable.book: Aʿlām al-Muwaqqiʿīn / überliefert von Ibn al-Qayyim
